evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and modifies common settings/JSON file writing utilities in src/common/settings.cpp and src/common/args.cpp.
rationale: Prevents data loss on crash or disk-full conditions by making WriteSettings write atomically via a temporary file and RenameOver. Without atomic replacement, commit 4a0f4916f6 notes that 'banlist.json could be left empty or partly written' during a crash or write failure, causing all peer bans to be discarded on restart.
